_brief: Batch 2026-10-03 item 10, MIC ON STREET / ABRAHM ACCORDS: individual answers, no intro. LESSONS 80: no zooms - each take keeps one constant full frame. This one: the young man in the blue cap who used to live in Dubai (C0524, his solo take). His first sentence IS the hook ('this is coming from somebody that used to live in Dubai. Now he lives in Israel.' - first word at 0.02s), so the answer runs in his order and the strongest line, 'at the end of the day, we're all brothers. We're family', lands as the payoff. One jump cut takes the 0.6s gap out. Then a hard cut to a DIFFERENT take - the same man with his five friends round the sign (C0523) - for 'We love you guys. Let's go!' and all of them cheering, arms up: the ending is the group, not him walking into the lens (C0524 14.3). Captions sit on his shirt (capY 0.47) in the close take, because the sign fills the lower half of that frame, and under the group in the wide take (0.80). grade:false. 'I've been around. They're both beautiful, beautiful countries. I think everyone should come visit Israel. You guys should for sure go to Dubai, because at the end of the day, we're all brothers. We're family.' (out before his 'Let's go' 13.08 - the group says it)

Style 5 breaks about two words a line and left a word like A / IN / THE / TO / WILL at a line end, or split MIDDLE EAST, on these captions. The builder makes each of them from two short pieces joined with a space; here both pieces carry the same two-line text (the second with a doubled space so it is not dropped as a repeat - it renders identically), so the caption shows once, unbroken, for the whole time both pieces are spoken.
